c.USER_ID AS cardOwnerUserId, uw.USER_NAME AS cardOwnerName, uw.USER_PHONE AS cardOwnerPhoneRaw, c.BALANCE_AMOUNT AS cardBalanceFen, c.BALANCE_ML AS cardBalanceMl, o.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, o.PACKAGE_SNAP AS packageSnap, o.PLAN_ML AS planMl, o.ACTUAL_ML AS actualMl, o.ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, o.PAY_WAY AS payWay, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.CMD_ID AS cmdId, o.FINISH_TIME AS finishTime, o.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason, o.CREATE_TIME AS createTime,
p.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, p.PAY_SOURCE AS paySource, p.TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, p.PAY_EXPIRE_TIME AS payExpireTime, p.PAY_SUCCESS_TIME AS paySuccessTime, p.DATA_STATUS AS paymentDataStatus,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ws_after_sale_action asa WHERE asa.ORDER_ID = o.ID AND asa.SOURCE_TYPE = #{afterSaleSourceType} AND asa.ACTION_STATUS = #{afterSaleSuccessStatus}) AS afterSaleConfirmed

FROM ws_order o LEFT JOIN ws_user u ON u.ID = o.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_station s ON s.ID = o.STATION_ID LEFT JOIN ws_device d ON d.ID = o.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN ws_device_outlet ot ON ot.ID = o.OUTLET_ID LEFT JOIN ws_card c ON c.ID = o.CARD_ID
LEFT JOIN ws_user uw ON uw.ID = c.USER_ID
LEFT JOIN ws_payment p ON p.ORDER_ID = o.ID

SELECT
WHERE o.DATA_STATUS = 0
AND o.ORDER_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.orderNo}, '%')
AND o.ORDER_TYPE = #{bo.orderType}
AND o.ORDER_STATUS = #{bo.orderStatus}
AND (u.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.userKeyword}, '%') OR u.USER_PHONE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.userKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.ID DESC

SELECT a.AFTER_SALE_NO AS afterSaleNo, a.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, a.ACTION_TYPE AS actionType, a.ACTION_STATUS AS actionStatus, a.APPROVED_COUNT AS approvedCount, a.REFUND_PRODUCT_FEN AS refundProductFen, a.REFUND_SERVICE_FEN AS refundServiceFen, a.REFUND_PRODUCT_ML AS refundProductMl, a.REFUND_AMOUNT AS refundAmount, r.REFUND_SOURCE AS refundSource, ro.ORDER_NO AS resendOrderNo, rt.TASK_NO AS resendTaskNo, a.FINISH_TIME AS finishTime FROM ws_after_sale_action a LEFT JOIN ws_refund r ON r.AFTER_SALE_ID = a.ID AND r.DATA_STATUS = 0 LEFT JOIN ws_order ro ON ro.ID = a.RESULT_ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_delivery_task rt ON rt.ID = a.RESULT_TASK_ID WHERE a.DATA_STATUS = 0 AND a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND (a.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} OR a.RESULT_ORDER_ID = #{orderId}) ORDER BY a.ID DESC LIMIT 1
